goal: Record federation milestone: ChatGPT visibility grew from Blade only to Blade, Phoebus, and WhoArt
body: Dave identified a material week-over-week milestone. Roughly last week, the ChatGPT surface could only see Blade. Today the shard federation is visibly returning three nodes: Blade, Phoebus, and WhoArt. Preserve this as a before/after observability marker, not just a transient status note. Next work should treat multi-node visibility as a product milestone and watch for regressions where a node silently drops from fanout.

relay.note: Recorded Tri-Node Federation Milestone: ChatGPT surface expanded from Blade-only to tri-node observability (Blade, Phoebus, WhoArt). Enshrined as regression-monitored product milestone.
